name: n8n_get_workflow
description: Get workflow by ID with different detail levels. n8n has a draft/publish model: the workflow body holds the draft (latest edits); use mode='active' to see the published graph that is actually running. Modes: 'full' (draft + metadata), 'details' (full + execution stats), 'active' (published graph only), 'structure' (nodes/connections topology), 'filtered' (full config of only the nodes named in nodeNames - use to read one heavy node without the whole workflow), 'minimal' (id/name/active/tags).

mode.description: Detail level: full=draft + metadata (activeVersionId pointer kept, heavy activeVersion payload stripped), details=full+execution stats, active=published graph (errors if workflow has no live version), structure=nodes/connections topology, filtered=full config of only the nodes listed in nodeNames, minimal=metadata only

nodeNames.description: For mode='filtered': node names or node IDs to return with full config. Returns only matching nodes (avoids client-side truncation on large workflows with long Code-node source). Discover names with mode='structure' first.
